Order your favourite dishes and snacks to your door with the Bolt Food delivery app.

Dive into a cheesy slice of pizza, savour a succulent burger, or munch on delicious snacks, all conveniently delivered to your door with just a few taps. Bolt Food has you covered for every mealtime whim, be it breakfast, lunch, dinner, or a quick snack. 

Skip the hassle of searching "food near me" or "places to eat near me" and choose from a variety of restaurants with the Bolt Food delivery app.

BOLT FOOD APP BENEFITS:
• An easy-to-use, intuitive interface.
• Real-time order and delivery tracking.
• Convenient order scheduling in advance.
• A pickup option for order collections.
• Discounts and takeaway deals.
• Seamless in-app payments (Google Pay, Apple Pay, credit/debit card).

HOW TO ORDER WITH BOLT FOOD:
• Set your delivery address;
• Pick a restaurant, store, or supermarket and add meals, food, snacks, and groceries to your basket;
• Tap to order and pay;
• Track your order progress and courier’s location in real time;
• Enjoy!

DISCOVER RESTAURANTS:
Explore a culinary world at your fingertips with Bolt Food. From beloved local eateries to renowned fast food chains like KFC, Burger King, and McDonald's, get meals from your favourite restaurants delivered to your door.

*BOLT MARKET:
Try Bolt Market, our fast grocery delivery service.

With Bolt Market, grocery shopping has never been easier. Say goodbye to long supermarket queues and carrying heavy bags. From essential groceries like milk and bread to speciality items like flowers and coffee, we've got you covered. Or maybe you need pet supplies, pharmacy essentials, or beauty and cosmetic products? Look no further — open the Bolt Market on the Bolt Food app and get items delivered.

Bolt Food was created by the European super-app, Bolt. It’s challenging the efficiency of the food and grocery delivery industry while helping shops and stores get more orders and enabling couriers to earn money.

Bolt Food is available in 80+ cities and 20 countries across Europe and Africa.

If you’d like to make some cash with your car, bike, or motorbike, become a Bolt Food courier: https://bolt.eu/en/food/courier/.

Or if you’re a restaurant, sign up as a Bolt Food partner: https://bolt.eu/en/food/partner/.

Get in touch with us via food@bolt.eu

Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/boltfood.
